headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.2
summary: Fixes the crash when opening the mod menu on Minecraft builds older than 26.60 by shipping both inbuilt-mods libraries and selecting per game version.

items.text: Opening the mod menu or enabling inbuilt mods on Minecraft builds older than 26.60 no longer crashes: both the 26.60-tuned and the legacy inbuilt-mods libraries now ship in the APK, and the launcher loads the one matching the selected game version.
